messages.author: 68b661fcb57b94a9
messages.subject: ggfluctuation
parts:
Hello,

Can anyone confirm that additional geoms (such as geom_text) cannot be used along with ggfluctuation?

And if so, what is a good alternative?

For example, can labels and alpha shading be added to the following somehow?

tmp<-data.frame(cnt=c(10,40,20,15),Group1=c("a","a","b","b"),Group2=c("c","d"))
tmp.tab<-xtabs(cnt~.,tmp)
ggfluctuation(tmp.tab)

Thanks very much.

Adam Loveland

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: ggfluctuation
parts:
Hi, you can use additional geom like this:

ggfluctuation(tmp.tab) + geom_text(aes(label=paste(x, y)))

but very confusing, so I recommend like this:

ggplot(tmp, aes(Group1, Group2, width=cnt/max(cnt),
height=cnt/max(cnt))) + geom_tile() +
geom_text(aes(label=paste(Group1, Group2)), colour="white")

--
